canonical_truth: Existing Define append-only source-bound session journal, not the design projection Entity
new_notes: NoteCommand is an inert typed proposal with command_ref, expected_revision, source_cut, kind, body binding and declared actor. The selected canonical journal adapter must validate actual body bytes/type, expected head/revision, session scope and source epoch before append.
idempotency: Same command_ref requires the same exact command/body/cut. A conflicting tuple refuses. Use the canonical writer existing lock/hash-chain/atomic publication/unknown-outcome reconciliation; no second truth journal or automatic duplicate dispatch.
projection: SessionProjection is an immutable cache row per observed journal snapshot; id is its identity. Its exact query selects id+session_ref+source_cut. New observations use fresh row identities; duplicate row IDs refuse. It can be discarded and reconstructed only from actual journal replay.
projection_reads: Return the snapshot/cut actually requested, not an implicit claim of currentness. NextForSession derives from that row; it does not accept caller fact counts.
commands: PrepareNote checks the cached expected revision/cut, then returns an inert candidate command. The canonical writer must recheck the actual journal before append, because a valid old cache can become stale.
queries_vs_derivation: ReadProjection retrieves a stored Entity. CalculateMissingFields, RecheckCount and CalculatePreparationStatus derive values; Rules validate their invariants; Mappings shape outputs.
epoch_compatibility: Explicit current-source journal protocol: ordinary commands keep v2; semantic notes use v3 with exact operation input/result and original-byte documents. Source epochs are never silently rebased; unsupported versions refuse.
closed_sessions: The compact snapshot retains closed state. Next action becomes ResumePreparation and NoteMatchesSession refuses authoring a note while closed. Existing session/question State Machines remain the lifecycle authority.
events: No Event or Workflow is declared or selected in this candidate. Handoff/acknowledgement are typed proposals/observations. Durable notifications would require their own chosen event-capable profile, emitter/receiver/payload/receipt and commit contract; no atomicity between separate file and SQL stores is assumed.
canonical_notes: The existing canonical writer commits a typed BindEvidence command plus a v3 semantic attachment; source, head, actual bytes, scope, operation results and package proofs are checked before publication. The evidence body is self-contained; normal prepare resolves it and its original document aliases from canonical history.
memoization: Only results already verified in this process can be reused for identical source, snapshot, command and original bytes. Pure results are cloned; generated artifacts and Definition schema/renderer resources remain source-pinned. No second durable note store is created.
